text:
ITEM 1 | Cubed pieces, roughly 1.5-2 cm each, pale cream-beige with light golden-brown browned edges, slightly glossy surface, moist-looking, firm and holding shape, scattered with small yellowish-green flecks and bits of darker seasoning between pieces, piled in a mound covering about 20% of the plate on the left-center | 120
ITEM 2 | Cut spears of green asparagus, about 12-14 cm long and 1 cm thick, bright green with slightly darker tips, firm, smooth surface, slight sheen, lying in a loose bundle diagonally across the lower-left of the plate, covering about 10% of the plate | 60
ITEM 3 | Chopped romaine-type lettuce, pale to medium green with white ribs, crisp and wilted in places, glossy with light dressing, mixed with thin pale shaved flakes (cheese-like) and a few small golden toasted bread cubes with browned crusts, piled on the right side covering about 15% of the plate | 70
ITEM 4 | Small golden-brown toasted bread cubes, about 1.5 cm, crisp and dry-looking with darker browned edges, scattered among the lettuce on the right | 15
ITEM 5 | Pale off-white thin shaved flakes, about 2-4 cm long and under 0.3 cm thick, dry and slightly translucent edges, scattered over the lettuce on the right | 10
